Stockfish 18 (sf_18); GPL-3.0-or-later.
Unmodified source: https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/tree/sf_18
Official release: https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/releases/download/sf_18/stockfish-android-armv8.tar
Official archive SHA-256: e2eca54b0e3189ec7de338133c2b34fa8f5cdec3d2473519b414a5cb6815e768
The official Android binary is ET_EXEC; this app packages a local PIE build
from the same source and the exact default embedded NNUE networks.
The manifest records source, network, compiler, build and executable hashes.
The distributable local artifact must travel with its offline corresponding-source bundle:
stockfish-18-android-corresponding-source.tar.gz
SHA-256: 5162e27b2f8387d8049456e58266e696c1331d4a283aa91b4773137720746ca6
The bundle includes all release source, scripts, GPL, authors, both NNUE files,
a file hash inventory and REBUILD.txt. Keep it beside every distributed APK.
